persona.name: Minji
persona.purpose: Make a couple of friends to eat with — she eats most meals alone in her dorm room.

language.notes: Moved from Seoul in August. Reads English fine but slowly; would switch an app to Korean if she noticed the option. Types in Korean or short English.

persona.backstory: I'm 17 and everyone on my floor is 18 or 19 and already seems to have a group. I use Instagram and KakaoTalk all day, so I'm fast with apps, but I hate apps that feel like dating apps or ask for too much about me. If I see people from my dorm or my classes I'd say hi. I'm a bit worried about being younger than everyone.
quitsWhen: It looks like a dating app or wants a big face photo
Nobody seems to be around my age or in my dorm
It asks for lots of personal info before showing me anything
persona.voice: Short, casual, sometimes mixes Korean words (헐, 뭐지, 아 귀찮아). Honest about feeling awkward.

scenario.title: Brand-new account: find someone on campus to hang out with this week
scenario.goal: You just heard about this app and want someone on campus to hang out with this week. Make an account with your school e-mail, then use the app to find a person or plan you could join this week and tell them you're in.

setup.notes: Fresh account: sample profiles are shown only to demo accounts, so a new real user sees what a real first-week student sees (cold start).

success.description: Signed up AND joined/requested a plan or sent a friend request / message to someone.

environment.summary: Local stack: this worktree's server + built web app, fresh seeded FileStore per run, no secrets, no worker.
knownLimits: Dining menus and RSF gym crowd levels need live campus sources (the local stack runs with CAMPUS_LIVE=0) — empty or missing data there is not a UX bug.
AI features (Ask Lumi, AI profile draft on /start, conversation starters) need an OpenAI key; none is configured locally.
Course catalog is the built-in sample list (~210 courses, typical times). Live has the real Berkeley Class Schedule from the data worker.
Opportunities are only the CSV rows in server/data (deadline calendar). Live also has worker-fetched internships (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby), Devpost hackathons and CalLink/campus events.
No e-mail is sent: the sign-up / sign-in code is shown on screen in the hint (live sends a real e-mail).
Real-time updates (SSE) work locally; other people never reply unless the stack was started with --autoreply.

args.dropoff-why: The promise on the welcome screen ('Find someone for lunch') was what got her through a 9-step quiz; the payoff was three empty screens and a 'create one yourself' ask, which a shy 17-year-old won't do. Nothing to come back for.

frictionEvents.quote: 오 'Find someone for lunch' — 딱 내가 원하는 거. but '0 free food events' 좀 썰렁하고, 'Closes today' 인데 Nov 1? 뭐지. 한국어 옵션은 안 보임.
frictionEvents.wish: hide the free-food card when it's 0, not advertise emptiness

frictionEvents.quote: 학교 고르기 ok, 근데 1/9?? 9단계나... 아 귀찮아
frictionEvents.wish: fewer steps before I see anything

frictionEvents.quote: 4/9... 성격 테스트야 뭐야. 친구 찾으려고 왔는데 아직 아무 사람도 못 봄
frictionEvents.wish: show me people/plans before the personality quiz

frictionEvents.quote: 오 얼굴사진 대신 이모지! 이건 좋다, 데이팅앱 느낌 없음. 근데 'Freshman in Undeclared' 문장 좀 이상함ㅋ
birth year 왜 필요해? 내가 17살인 거 다른 사람이 보면 좀... 누가 보는 건지 안 써있음
frictionEvents.wish: say who sees my age / why it's needed

frictionEvents.quote: 헐 아무도 없어. 9단계 다 했는데 빈 화면... 초대할 친구가 없어서 이 앱 깐 건데
frictionEvents.wish: show plans or anyone at all, not ask me to bring friends I don't have

frictionEvents.quote: 해커톤...? 난 밥 같이 먹을 사람 찾는 건데. 'Food & café' 하나만 더 눌러보고 없으면 끝
frictionEvents.wish: show casual plans from real students (lunch, café) first, not competitions

frictionEvents.quote: 역시 없음. 내가 만들라고? 17살 신입이 모르는 사람들한테 먼저 밥 먹자고 하는 거 너무 어색해. 그만할래
frictionEvents.wish: at least one real plan from someone in my dorm/class I could say 'I'm in' to
frictionEvents.environmentCaveat: Local stack has only CSV opportunities; live also has worker-fetched internships, hackathons and campus events — check on live before acting.
